wine-11.0/0001-winebus.patch: A USB pad's container comes from its location ID, so a game can pair it with its audio
wine-11.0/0002-winecoreaudio.patch: The pad's audio endpoints answer DEVPKEY_Device_ContainerId with the pad's container
wine-11.0/0003-mmdevapi.patch: An active endpoint's container is asked of the driver, not read from the registry
wine-11.0/0004-winebus-bluetooth.patch: A Bluetooth DualSense or Edge is shown to the game as the same pad on a cable
wine-11.0/0005-winecoreaudio-bluetooth.p: A Bluetooth pad gets the audio output its wired self would have, for its haptics
wine-11.0/0006-winebus-xinput-and-trigge: XInput's rumble on the pad's motors, trigger effects chosen in Game Feel, a steadier Bluetooth stream
wine-11.0/0007-hidclass-xinput.patch: A pad with a haptics collection is also offered to XInput
wine-11.0/0008-xinput-sony-order.patch: XInput reads a Sony pad's own descriptor in Sony's order
wine-11.0/0009-mmdevapi-setupapi-endpoin: Audio endpoints are listed through SetupAPI as Windows lists them, with the pad's container
wine-11.0/0010-setupapi-base-containerid: SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA returns SPDRP_BASE_CONTAINERID as a WCHAR string, as Windows does
wine-11.0/0011-xaudio2-mastering-voice-d: An XAudio2 mastering voice opens the device the game names, not the default one
wine-11.0/0012-winecoreaudio-edge-output: An Edge shown as a DualSense has the DualSense's audio device on a cable too
wine-11.0/0013-winebus-dualshock4.patch: The pad shown to a game as a USB DualShock 4 (pad_as=dualshock4)
wine-11.0/0014-winebus-trigger-replace-a: A chosen trigger effect can replace the game's own, and Game Feel's changes reach a running game
wine-11.0/0015-winebus-input-rate-once-a: With diagnostics on, the pad's input rate is logged once a minute, not every 2 s
wine-11.0/0016-winebus-rumble-flag-0x02-: Over Bluetooth a game report with the rumble flag 0x02 alone keeps the motors, as the pad does on a cable
wine-11.0/0017-ntdll-rosetta-cpu-fidelit: Under Rosetta the CPU looks more like the x86 one copy protection checks for: CPUID leaf 7 bits on request, CLWB and RDPID, debug-register breakpoints, non-canonical faults
wine-11.0/0018-ntdll-d3dmetal-fallback.p: A 64-bit process with CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal finds D3DMetal's DLLs first, even when CrossOver did not route it
wine-11.0/0019-ntdll-rosetta-smc-cpuid.p: Under Rosetta, a cpuid that self-modifying code wrote right before running it, which Rosetta skips and faults after, is run by ntdll
wine-11.0/0020-ntdll-rosetta-cpuid-by-de: Rosetta's CPUID bits are on for every process unless WINE_ROSETTA_CPUID7_OR=0, and each emulated CLWB or RDPID is counted in the log

wine-11.21/0023-ntdll-fh6-exception-disp: Forza Horizon 6's opt-in, build-guarded exception dispatcher and NotProton's Steam client bridge in ntdll, ported from the 41073 pair; Intel side, with ntdll.dll
wine-11.21/0024-ntdll-fh6-bridge-lea-inc: FH6's register bridge also stages LEA, INC, byte XOR and TEST and register MUL, committing both MUL results only after the jump checks pass; Intel side, ntdll.dll only
wine-11.21/0025-ntdll-fh6-chain-on-by-de: For the build-guarded FH6 executable the exception chain and the ALU bridge are on by default, so its launch options no longer need them; =0 still turns either off; Intel side, ntdll.dll only
wine-11.21/0026-ntdll-dualstack-ipv4-opt: An IPv4 option macOS refuses on an IPv6 socket (IP_DONTFRAGMENT, IP_TTL, IP_MULTICAST_TTL, IP_MULTICAST_LOOP) is set as its IPv6 counterpart, which reaches the socket's IPv4-mapped traffic: FH6 keeps its dual-stack UDP game socket and joins online sessions; both sides, ntdll.so
wine-11.21/0027-ntdll-dualstack-ipv4-opt: WINE_DUALSTACK_IPV4_OPTIONS=0 turns 0026 off for a program, which then sees macOS's refusal as before; on by default; both sides, ntdll.so
wine-11.21/0028-ntdll-direct-syscall-und: Under Rosetta, a thread that makes a system call with a syscall instruction of its own while another thread suspends it is no longer lost and no longer skips the call: a SIGSYS that lands on top of the suspend handler, or never arrives, is entered when that handler is done; WINE_DIRECT_SYSCALL_DEFERRAL=0 turns it off; Intel side, ntdll.so
wine-11.21/0029-ntdll-exception-ahead-of: Under Rosetta, an exception raised by a thread that another thread is suspending no longer ends it with 'nested exception on signal stack': a fault delivered ahead of the suspend handler is left to happen again, and a breakpoint is replayed; under 0028's switch; Intel side, ntdll.so
wine-11.21/0030-winebus-bluetooth-pad-us: A Bluetooth pad shown as wired is a USB device with its location's container again, as its haptics output has: Wine 11.21 took the USB bus type back from it and answers a container only for devices with several interfaces
wine-11.21/0031-ntdll-diagnostic-stores-: FH6's diagnostic stores are allocated when a capture is switched on instead of sitting in ntdll.dll: 40 MB of static storage gave the file a shape copy protection that reads system32\ntdll.dll from disk (2XKO's) refuses
wine-11.21/0032-ntdll-writecopy-pagefile: A copy-on-write view of a page-file section is mapped writable and shared outside Linux; 2XKO's copy protection needs it. From NotProton's creator
wine-11.21/0033-win32u-draw-into-other-p: A window surface flushed to another process's top-level window is drawn at the window's visible origin, for the Riot Client's Electron window. From NotProton's creator
wine-11.21/0034-kernelbase-device-paths-: GetMappedFileNameW answers with a device path (\Device\HarddiskVolume1\...), as Windows does, which copy protection checks. From NotProton's creator
wine-11.21/0035-user32-GetPointerDevice-: GetPointerDevice exists and fails with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, for games that import it (2XKO). From NotProton's creator
wine-11.21/0036-ntdll-writecopy-shared-o: 0032's shared copy-on-write views only in the Riot Client's and 2XKO's processes (Lion.exe, Lion-Win64-Shipping.exe, RiotClient*.exe, Riot Client.exe): every other program keeps its own writes to such a view, as on Windows. WINE_WRITECOPY_SHARED=1 or 0 turns it on or off
wine-11.21/0037-ntdll-tcp-noopt-on-reque: WINE_TCP_NOOPT=1, or NotProton's notproton-tcp-noopt file beside the prefix, connects the process's TCP sockets with macOS's TCP_NOOPT (no MSS, window scale, SACK or timestamps), which Red Dead Online needs; from NotProton's creator's wineserver patch, set from ntdll on the same socket; off by default; both sides, ntdll.so
wine-11.21/0043-win32u-shm-surface-flush: A window drawn from another process is not flushed while Wine's USER lock is held. Forza Horizon 5's Xbox sign-in page (WebView2) stopped on Wine's lock check there, and the game closed with it
